aliases: QuarkView DM13EP 5MP PoE Dome Camera with 2.8mm Lens
release_notes: Specs per the official QuarkView product page (Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.); the page states 5MP (2592x1944) at 15 fps, a fixed 2.8 mm lens, 48V PoE, H.265, 15 IR LEDs with a 15 m IR distance and a built-in microphone (no speaker or two-way talk specified); it is positioned for indoor rooms. The page explicitly says no viewing angle is published. RTSP path from the QuarkView fixed PoE camera family manual linked on the page (main stream only; default user admin with an empty password, default IP 192.168.1.10); the same manual states ONVIF and RTSP support. Sensor, IP rating and dimensions are not published.

frigate.notes: Main-stream path from the QuarkView fixed PoE camera family manual (Xiongmai platform). The manual does not document a sub-stream; on Xiongmai firmware it is usually stream=1.sdp, but confirm via ONVIF discovery before using it for detect. Set a password first: the factory password is empty.

home_assistant.notes: Use the ONVIF integration; the manual lists ONVIF support but not the ONVIF port.

blue_iris.notes: Add as a generic ONVIF/RTSP camera (Xiongmai platform).
